purpose: City-specific official registry and public parcel geometry source review for the ranked WUP point.
scopeLimits: One point-intersecting public parcel sample only; citywide completeness and legal-title conclusions are outside this evidence.
assessment: Official city registry evidence was found and a public parcel polygon was verified at the exact WUP point.
registryAssessment: The Düsseldorf Vermessungs- und Katasteramt maintains the city cadastral/Geoportal services; the city Geoportal describes over 120,000 searchable Flurstücke and the NRW ALKIS WFS returns a parcel polygon covering the ranked point.

searchQueries.query: Düsseldorf ALKIS WFS Geobasis NRW Flurstücke polygon WFS official
searchQueries.scope: Find a public official parcel layer, safe native parcel identifier, and exact coverage at Düsseldorf’s ranked point.
searchQueries.result: The City of Düsseldorf Geoportal and Geoshop document the municipal cadastral office and parcel mapping. Geobasis NRW publishes the INSPIRE CadastralParcel WFS in EPSG:25832. A bounded 2 m envelope around the ranked point returned one Polygon carrying nationalCadastralReference; GEOS confirms it covers the point.
searchQueries.executionMethod: Separate English search, official city map/catalog pages, WFS capabilities/schema inspection, and one anonymous geometry query capped at three features.

searchQueries.query: Düsseldorf offizielle ALKIS Flurstücke WFS Geoportal Katasterkarte
searchQueries.scope: Das kommunale Liegenschaftskataster und den anonym nutzbaren Flurstücksdienst am Rangpunkt prüfen.
searchQueries.result: Das Geoportal Düsseldorf und der GeoShop beschreiben das Liegenschaftskataster und Flurstücke. Der offizielle NRW-WFS „cp:CadastralParcel“ verwendet EPSG:25832. Eine begrenzte 2-m-Abfrage am WUP-Punkt lieferte ein gültiges Polygon, das den Punkt enthält; gespeichert wurden nur Geometrie und Flurstücksreferenz.
searchQueries.executionMethod: Getrennte deutschsprachige Recherche, Prüfung offizieller Stadtseiten und WFS-Metadaten sowie eine anonyme, begrenzte Abfrage.

sampleValidation.validationTool: GEOS 3.14.1 geosop isValid and covers on the transformed sample

geometryDecision: One official NRW cadastral polygon covers the ranked point. A sanitized CRS84 sample retains only gml:id, nationalCadastralReference and geometry; this is one sample and does not prove citywide completeness.

rootRuntimeReview.reason: 162 valid, distinct NRW ALKIS cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Düsseldorf WUP locator. Complete offset paging, forced three-row pages, all 162 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32632 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. The existing North Rhine-Westphalia provider is reused. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
